pinata_page.description: Read the next bounded fragment of an immutable tool reply using its nextCursor. Concatenate text fragments in offset order to recover the complete original JSON. Cursors expire when their host closes; re-query the original read operation for a fresh cursor.

pinata_run.description: Create or extend a run, queue a follow-up, explicitly continue stopped work, change optional capacity, or release a foreground wait. Start with command: {kind: "create", workers: [{id: "worker", agent: "builder", task: "Your assignment"}]}. Put workspace, backend, lifetime, observeWorkspace and context in each worker entry; optional run configuration belongs in command.config. Omit inheritContext unless parent conversation import is explicitly granted; include needed context in task. Workers use frozen definitions and grants; the coordinator decides testing and acceptance.

pinata_steer.description: Record instructions for an active or queued assignment. The receipt distinguishes durable acceptance from transport and consumption.

pinata_cancel.description: Cancel an assignment, worker or run. Partial output is retained; confirmed cleanup is reported separately.

pinata_integrate.description: Explicitly apply a selected isolated snapshot with destination exclusion and conflict checks. This does not certify correctness. Inspect the application outcome using its operation ID.

pinata_rollback.description: Roll back one journaled application if the destination still matches. Later edits are preserved or reported as conflicts.

pinata_schedule.description: Manage a session-owned one-shot, interval or cron trigger. Occurrences are ordinary assignments; closed sessions cannot fire.

inputs.description: Workspace snapshots to compose, NOT reports or conversation. For report synthesis use after for ordering, query result/conversation, and supply report text in context.

context.description: Quoted context text, such as upstream report contents. Assignment references in inputs do not import reports.

pinata_wait.description: Wait for exact assignments or the next pending completion. Aborting this wait leaves workers running.

pinata_status.description: Inspect state, exact results, immutable conversation pages, schema discovery, receipts or an application outcome. Tool input schemas are already supplied: no schema query is needed before launching. For discovery use name: pinata.command.v1, or a tool name such as pinata_run; avoid fetching the entire registry. Results are execution observations, not acceptance decisions.

pinata_agents.description: Discover compact agent descriptions, defaults and effective launch grants. Full instructions remain available through pinata_status query kind definitions.

pinata_changes.description: Inspect a selected assignment's retained workspace snapshot, including failed or cancelled partial work.

pinata_recover.description: Explicitly reattach original owned attempts or reconcile stopped work from retained evidence. Recovery never blindly relaunches an uncertain attempt.

pinata_page.availability: Only for previously returned child-tool output in this worker's current session; cursors do not grant arbitrary artifact access.

pinata_dependency.availability: Only for immutable dependency results assigned to this worker; pages contain complete result JSON, not the contents of referenced report or transcript artifacts.

submit_result.availability: Optional reporting; outputType may refine the data field.

cliHelp:
Usage:
  pinata run <job.json|-> [--json] [--watch]       run a finite schema-1 job
  pinata serve [job.json] [--directory <run>]     own a runtime and serve authenticated control
  pinata attach <run-directory> [--watch]         browse in a terminal; otherwise print status
  pinata view <run-directory> [--control] [--palette name]  open the live/saved viewer
  pinata request <run-directory> <request.json|-> [--control]
  pinata execute <run-directory> <envelope.json|->
  pinata query <run-directory> <query.json|->
  pinata status|logs <run-directory> [--watch] [--json]
  pinata result|conversation|changes <run-directory> <worker> [assignment]
  pinata wait <run-directory> [worker ...] [--next]
  pinata steer|follow-up|continue <run-directory> <worker> <message>
  pinata cancel <run-directory> [--scope assignment|worker|run] [--worker id] [--assignment n]
  pinata background|recover <run-directory>
  pinata apply <run-directory> <worker> <assignment> --destination <checkout>
  pinata rollback <run-directory> <operation> --destination <checkout>
  pinata reconcile <run-directory> <operation> --owner <epoch>
  pinata bind-checkout <checkout> <manifest.json> --reason <reason>
  pinata schema [name] --json                    generated canonical JSON Schema
  pinata agents [list|show <name>|validate]        discover Markdown definitions
  pinata tools --json                            discover coordinator tool schemas

Host options: --workspace, --directory, --run, --agent-dir, --definitions (repeatable),
--config <json>, --grants <json>, --model <provider/id>, --thinking <level>, --bootstrap <module>.
--factory <module> selects a trusted development host factory exporting openHost.
Control commands attach to a live owning server. Saved runs remain read-only; start
serve explicitly to claim one. Aborting an attached wait leaves work running.
Exit codes: 0 completed/observed, 1 execution or application failed/uncertain,
2 invalid or rejected request, 3 cancelled. Completion does not certify correctness.
